name: game-balance-check
description: > Validates and tunes game balance: economy faucets and sinks, progression and difficulty curves, reward pacing, win rates and dominant strategies, using agent-runnable simulations (Monte Carlo, AI-vs-AI) and telemetry. Use for "balance", "tuning", "difficulty spike", "Monte Carlo", "win rate". Not for designing currencies or monetization (use game-economy-designer).
